answers.core: I didn't find a way to do this using a plugin.
answers.workaround:
workarounds could be:
- setting the `editor_layout.cfg` `opened_scenes` setting manually before loading the project (`restore scenes on load` should be on in `EditorSettings`)
- before closing the project, manually switch to a scene that should be opened on the next loading (`restore scenes on load` should be on as well)
-

title: Add a way to open a predefined scene on load in editor
